identity.name: TechCrunch
identity.description: An American technology-news website covering startups, venture capital, products and the business of technology.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Owned by Yahoo Inc., which is controlled by Apollo Global Management. Commercial technology publisher with a startup and venture-capital focus.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Technology trade coverage with bylined reporting; ownership by Yahoo/Apollo creates commercial pressures but no evident party line.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Left-Center and High factual reporting; coverage is business/technology focused rather than politically mobilised.

economicPerspective.evidence: Startup and venture coverage generally assumes market-led innovation and investor perspectives.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames technology through US startup and venture-capital networks, with limited geopolitical analysis.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; established technology publication with corrections.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Technology-business insider. Covers innovation through startup funding, product cycles and platform economics, with a generally optimistic, investor-literate framing.

selectionRationale: Adds structured technology and startup coverage that general international outlets treat episodically.

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping retained. Ownership verified through official About page and Wikipedia. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
